about: Eight years of rheumatoid arthritis have left the person needing help dressing, the DAS28 is 5.6 and the only ciclosporin supply is for eye use.
The record shows rheumatoid arthritis, and methotrexate (Methoblastin) is supplied about every seven weeks up to the end, so a disease-modifying medicine is in place.
The DAS28 is high and no DMARD is supplied, but the record documents unrestricted daily function despite long-standing rheumatoid arthritis.
